class Public {
  kind = 'public';
  constructor() {}
}
class Hidden {
  kind = 'hidden';
  private constructor() {}
  static create(flag: boolean) {
    const C = flag ? Public : Hidden;
    return new C();
  }
}
class Protected {
  kind = 'protected';
  protected constructor() {}
}
class Child extends Protected {
  constructor() { super(); }
  static create(flag: boolean) {
    const C = flag ? Public : Protected;
    return new C();
  }
}
function privateForward(flag: boolean) { const C = flag ? Public : Hidden; return new C(); }
function privateReverse(flag: boolean) { const C = flag ? Hidden : Public; return new C(); }
function protectedForward(flag: boolean) { const C = flag ? Public : Protected; return new C(); }
function protectedReverse(flag: boolean) { const C = flag ? Protected : Public; return new C(); }
function generic<T extends typeof Public | typeof Hidden>(C: T) { return new C(); }
function assigned(C: typeof Public | typeof Hidden) { return new C(); }
function assignedReverse(C: typeof Hidden | typeof Public) { return new C(); }
class Width {
  kind = 'wide';
  constructor(value?: number) {}
}
class WidthHidden {
  kind = 'narrow';
  private constructor(value?: 1) {}
}
function mixedArity(C: typeof Width | typeof WidthHidden) { return new C(1); }
class EmptyA { constructor() {} }
class EmptyB { private constructor() {} }
function emptyForward(flag:boolean) { const C = flag ? EmptyA : EmptyB; return new C(); }
function emptyReverse(flag:boolean) { const C = flag ? EmptyB : EmptyA; return new C(); }
function emptyVariable(C: typeof EmptyA | typeof EmptyB) { return new C(); }
class AForCross { value = 1; constructor() {} }
class BForCross { hidden = 'x'; private constructor() {} }
function cross(flag:boolean) { const C = flag ? AForCross : BForCross; return new C(); }
let publicFactory: typeof EmptyA = EmptyB;
let protectedFactory: typeof Protected = Hidden;
const explicitPrivate: new () => Hidden = Hidden;
const explicitProtected: new () => Protected = Protected;
function make<T>(C: new () => T): T { return new C(); }
make(Hidden);
make(Protected);
